pmc.title: Fitness · fatigue · form
pmc.aria: CTL and ATL lines with TSB bars over the last 90 days
pmc.tip:
Fitness, fatigue and form over the last 90 days.
How to read: blue CTL = fitness (42-day average load), orange ATL = fatigue (7 days); bars TSB = yesterday's CTL − ATL, coloured by TSB ÷ CTL: red < −30% High Risk, green −30 to −10% Optimal, light purple −10 to +5% grey zone, purple +5 to +25% Fresh, yellow > +25% Transition.
Look for: blue rising = getting fitter; orange above blue = training more than usual lately; negative TSB is not bad.
Method: the TrainingPeaks PMC; bands from Friel, rules of thumb, a direction only.
thr.wait_cool: The LTHR test is more accurate once it cools down (you can still schedule it now)
drift.basis_power: HR drift from power (power ÷ HR, Pw:HR)
drift.basis_pace: HR drift from pace (speed ÷ HR, Pa:HR)
z5.title: Zone 3 / Zone 5 unlock tracks
split.title: Intensity distribution
split.tip:
Moving time of this period's endurance activities, split into three heart-rate bands.
How to read: low < AeT, moderate AeT–LTHR, high ≥ LTHR; bar length = share.
Look for: 75% low intensity is the floor, 80% the target (≥ 90% in base); this is a reminder, not a condition for unlocking Zone 3.
Method: Seiler 2006.
